Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
FAQ: How do I set up two-factor authentication?

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable 2FA, go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and click Enable. We support authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS verification. Authenticator apps are recommended over SMS for stronger security. After enabling 2FA, you will be prompted for a verification code at each login.
--- End Document 2 ---

final_answer: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is a security measure that requires multiple credentials, such as a password and a one-time code sent to a user's mobile device, to verify a user's identity. This adds an extra layer of security to prevent unauthorized access. MFA is implemented through the use of authenticator apps or SMS, with authenticator apps being recommended for stronger security. The process of setting up MFA involves going to the settings, selecting "Security" and "Two-Factor Authentication," and then enabling the feature. MFA is widely used in various contexts, including online banking, social media, and email services.
